answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing.
